label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) is alert-TP. User-controlled parameter name flows directly to HTML output via PrintWriter.format without sanitization. The parameter name is extracted from request.getParameterNames(), assigned to 'param', passed to 'bar', placed in an Object array 'obj', and printed into the response body. X-XSS-Protection header is disabled ('0'), exacerbating the risk. No encoding occurs between source and sink.

evidence.note: User input captured in 'param' based on parameter name matching a value
Tainted 'param' flows to 'bar', then 'obj', finally written unsanitized to HTML response via out.format()
